correctness.rationale: With iid renewal gaps 0<w_-<=W<=w_+ and iid independent defective hit delays U, Q(t)=E product_{S_i<=t}(1-G(t-S_i)). The sandwich g_(1-p)(t)<=Q(t)<=g_(1-G(K))(t-K) is correct since ignored births contribute factors <=1. With cE exp(theta W)=1, tilting on first overshooting gap gives g_c(t)=c^-1 E_tilde exp(-theta S_(N_t+1)), bounded between c^-1 exp[-theta(t+w_+)] and c^-1 exp(-theta t). Continuous theta_c squeeze as G(K) to p yields exact log rate. Strict convex-order monotonicity/Jensen yields fixed-mean constant-gap optimizer; Poisson survival exp[-b integral G] gives bp, and Pareto first waiting time gives zero exponent but a.s. reaction by infinitely many geometric successes. Independent computed roots for p=.1,.4,.8 in deterministic and two-point clocks and checked ordering; finite tests do not certify the asymptotic; single-particle Brownian p=exp(-L sqrt(d/D)) follows killed harmonic ODE. Scope excludes general unbounded light-tailed renewal law and finite-time survival ordering.
